code = r'''
import torch, time
M=64*56*56
torch.manual_seed(0)
a=torch.randn(M,128,device='cuda'); w=torch.randn(512,128,device='cuda')
h=torch.randn(M,512,device='cuda')*10; w2=torch.randn(128,512,device='cuda')
r1=(a.double()@w.double().t()); r2=(h.double()@w2.double().t())
def t(f):
    for _ in range(3): f()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(); s=time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(20): f()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(); return (time.perf_counter()-s)/20*1e6
c1=a@w.t(); c2=h@w2.t()
print("gemm1 %.1f us maxerr %.2e | gemm2 %.1f us maxerr %.2e" % (t(lambda: a@w.t()), (c1.double()-r1).abs().max(), t(lambda: h@w2.t()), (c2.double()-r2).abs().max()))
print(getattr(torch.backends.cuda.matmul,'fp32_precision',None))
'''

    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True)

import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
torch.manual_seed(1); dev='cuda'
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
def ref(x,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,eps, mm=None):
    h=F.linear(x,w1,b1) if mm is None else mm(x,w1)+b1
    h=F.gelu(h)
    G=torch.linalg.vector_norm(h,ord=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True)
    nf=G/(G.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+eps)
    h=gw*(h*nf)+gb+h
    return F.linear(h,w2,b2) if mm is None else mm(h,w2)+b2
def tf32r(t):
    i=t.contiguous().view(torch.int32); i=(i+0x1000)&~0x1fff; return i.view(torch.float32)
def split16(t, s):  # hi fp16, lo fp16 scaled by s
    hi=t.half().float(); lo=((t-hi)*s).half().float()/s; return hi,lo
def mm_f16x3(a,w,s=1.0):
    ah,al=split16(a,s); wh,wl=split16(w,s); return ah@wh.t()+(ah@wl.t()+al@wh.t())
def mm_3tf32_drop(a,w):  # 2-term: a_hi*w_full_tf32split? (ah*wh + ah*wl) i.e. a only hi
    ah=tf32r(a); al=tf32r(a-ah); wh=tf32r(w); wl=tf32r(w-wh); return ah@wh.t()+al@wh.t()+ah@wl.t()
def mm_tf32x2(a,w):  # ah*wh + al*wh (w hi only)
    ah=tf32r(a); al=tf32r(a-ah); wh=tf32r(w); return ah@wh.t()+al@wh.t()
for (B,H,W,atol) in [(16,14,14,0.0028),(16,56,56,0.003)]:
    x=torch.randn(B,H,W,128,device=dev); w1=torch.randn(512,128,device=dev); b1=torch.randn(512,device=dev)
    gw=torch.randn(1,1,1,512,device=dev); gb=torch.randn(1,1,1,512,device=dev); w2=torch.randn(128,512,device=dev); b2=torch.randn(128,device=dev)
    r=ref(x,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,1e-6)
    def rep(name,o):
        d=(o.double()-r.double()).abs(); tol=atol+1e-5*r.double().abs()
        print('  %-14s maxerr %.2e  fail %.4f%%'%(name,d.max(),100*(d>tol).float().mean()))
    print(B,H,W)
    for nm,f in [('f16x3',mm_f16x3),('f16x3 s2^12',lambda a,w: mm_f16x3(a,w,4096.0)),('3tf32',mm_3tf32_drop),('tf32x2 (w hi)',mm_tf32x2)]:
        rep(nm,ref(x,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,1e-6,mm=lambda a,w,f=f: f(a.reshape(-1,a.shape[-1]),w).reshape(*a.shape[:-1],w.shape[0])))
